stations_rule: status == included in data/processed/coverage.csv (<= 10% missing storage days)

primary_model.name: HGB SWE no weather
primary_model.snow_anomaly_climatology: smoothed day-of-year mean of basin SWE from snow index dates < 2024-01-01, Gaussian sigma 10 days

secondary_models: Ridge (v1 features, StandardScaler + RidgeCV alphas logspace(-2,3,20))
baselines: Monthly seasonal (station x origin month mean of training targets)
Smoothed DOY seasonal (station, Gaussian kernel sigma 15 days on origin day of year over training targets)

interval.calibration: absolute out-of-fold residuals of the primary model from development folds WY2008-2023 (results/v2/development/oof_predictions.csv), 90th percentile (method=higher) per origin season DJF/MAM/JJA/SON, fallback global if a group has < 150 residuals

bootstrap.type: moving-block over weekly origin dates, all reservoirs on a date resampled jointly

metrics: interval coverage and mean width overall, by reservoir, by season
primary minus strongest baseline with block CIs
primary minus monthly seasonal with block CIs
paired v1 GBM vs v2 primary on rows with identical target definitions
